notes_for_editor: NO STORY WRITTEN (held). The only readable lookout-specific source is the Canada Lookouts index entry, which carries the name and nothing else (cite 4). Wikipedia (cite 1) describes the hamlet, not a tower. No source read places the lookout relative to the hamlet, so any hamlet facts would read as the lookout's history. Cites 2 and 3 are system-wide context and not enough for a site history. PROTECTED DATA: the record's built year (2011), height (24 m), elevation, exact coordinates, access and staffing come only from the Alberta WF_WILDFIRE_LOOKOUT layer, which its metadata (data/raw/expansion/prairies-north/ab_lookout_layer0_meta.json) marks Protected, not for display on maps at 1:1,000,000 or larger or on maps with local roads seen by the public. None of those values is used here. Not used: two Alberta Emergency Alerts for Conklin (2025 and 2026) about wildfire near the hamlet. They do not name the lookout. Leads: the Provincial Archives of Alberta description 'Fire Maps, Lookout towers, Ranger Districts' returned no readable text. An AMS paper, 'The History of Wildfire Detection In Alberta' (Tim Klein), read through WebFetch, names none of the three lookouts. Searches used: 2 (websearch.py).
